title: Actually run the repository gate for self-patches (VC-201-015)
goal: VC-201-015 refuted: the gate parses a caller-supplied transcript and never executes fmt/clippy/test, so a fabricated 'all pass' transcript promotes a candidate that ran nothing; duplicate keys are last-write-wins so a real failure followed by a forged 'pass' promotes; command_covers_full_gate is substring matching that accepts never-executed strings and 'cargo test --lib' as covering the workspace gate; repo_gate has no production caller. Evidence: crates/susi-gawd/src/tests/vc_201_015_mastery.rs.
